response.sql:
WITH driver_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.driverId,
    SUM(CAST(r.points AS REAL)) AS total_points,
    AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
  FROM results AS r
  WHERE CAST(r.grid AS INTEGER) >= 12
  GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total,
  AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps
FROM driver_totals;

assumptions.assumption: “Across those drivers” means average each driver’s points summed across all qualifying race results, then average those driver totals; laps are averaged per driver over qualifying results with nonmissing laps, and those per-driver averages are averaged equally. Grid position 12 or higher qualifies.
